description: This file is a shell script used for testing the built-in diff output engine in a Git-related testing framework. It contains test cases that verify the behavior of various 'git diff-files' command options, prepares test files and directories, and compares expected output with actual output during test execution.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks the results.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output with the expected output from a file.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares two diff patch outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
